Interface MenuEntry

BoundCommand, MenuEntry.Dynamic, MenuSpec, Separator
public sealed interface MenuEntry permits BoundCommand, Separator, MenuSpec, MenuEntry.Dynamic

  • Method Details

    • dynamic

      static MenuEntry.Dynamic dynamic(Observable<? extends List<? extends DynamicEntry>> entries)
      Returns a section of a menu whose entries come from an observable. When the observable changes, the framework rebuilds that section of every menu created from the description, on the EDT, in the scope the menu was built in.
      Parameters:
      entries - the entries of the section
      Returns:
      the dynamic section
